versions.changelog:
Initial release of literature-daily-report.

- Automates daily literature report generation and management for life sciences × AI.
- Fetches latest publications from PubMed, bioRxiv, and arXiv based on customizable queries.
- Filters and categorizes articles with semantic keyword matching in fields like AI, bioinformatics, pathogens, and fungi.
- Uses LLM to generate structured, concise Chinese summaries and edits reports in markdown format.
- Supports scheduled tasks, automatic file organization, ClawLib syncing, and Zotero group library integration.
